```{r}
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(eisaR)
library(tidyverse)
library(rtracklayer)
library(QuasR)
library(Rhisat2)
library(readxl)
```


```{r}
# Replace with the path to your own GTF file
gtf_file <- "C:/your/path/v4.3.2.gtf"

# Create TxDb from GTF
txdb <- makeTxDbFromGFF(gtf_file, format = "gtf")

```


```{r}
regS <- getRegionsFromTxDb(txdb = txdb, strandedData = TRUE)
```

```{r}
regU <- getRegionsFromTxDb(txdb = txdb, strandedData = FALSE)
```

```{r}
lengths(regS)
```
```{r}
lengths(regU)
```

```{r}
regS$exons
```

```{r}

export(regS$exons, "hg19sub_exons_stranded.gtf")
export(regS$genebodies, "hg19sub_genebodies_stranded.gtf")
```



```{r}
sampleFile <- "C:/your/path/sampleFileFull.txt"
```

```{r}
read.delim(sampleFile)
```


```{r}
## Perform the alignment
proj <- qAlign(sampleFile = sampleFile, 
               genome = "C:/your/path/danRer11.primary.fa",
               aligner = "Rhisat2", splicedAlignment = TRUE)
```

```{r}
alignmentStats(proj)
```

```{r}
cntEx <- qCount(proj, regU$exons, orientation = "any")
```


```{r}
cntGb <- qCount(proj, regU$genebodies, orientation = "any")
```


```{r}
cntIn <- cntGb - cntEx
```

```{r}
cntEx
```


```{r}
cntIn
```


```{r}

Lawson <- read_excel("C:/your/path/elife-55792-fig3-data6-v2.xlsx")
Lawson <- data.frame(Lawson)
Lawson <- Lawson[, c('LLgeneID', 'EnsdargID', 'ID')]
colnames(Lawson) <- c('gene_id', 'EnsdargID', 'gene_name')
head(Lawson)
```



```{r}
Rex <- cntEx[, colnames(cntEx) != "width"]
Rin <- cntIn[, colnames(cntIn) != "width"]
```

```{r}
all(rownames(Rex) %in% Lawson$gene_id)
```
```{r}
setdiff(rownames(Rex), Lawson$gene_id)

```

```{r}
rownames(Rex) <- trimws(rownames(Rex))
Lawson$gene_id <- trimws(Lawson$gene_id)

```

```{r}
all(rownames(Rex) %in% Lawson$gene_id)

```
```{r}
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(Rex), Lawson$gene_id)
Rex <- Rex[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
gene_map <- setNames(Lawson$gene_name, Lawson$gene_id)
rownames(Rex) <- gene_map[rownames(Rex)]

```


```{r}
common_ids <- intersect(rownames(Rin), Lawson$gene_id)
Rin <- Rin[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
gene_map <- setNames(Lawson$gene_name, Lawson$gene_id)
rownames(Rin) <- gene_map[rownames(Rin)]

```

Rex
